t: Grok3 is Free Until Our Servers Melt
s: Grok3 offers a unique, albeit resource-intensive, AI experience, prioritizing a 'bad-boy' attitude and deep integration with X.com, now accessible via grok.com with improved markdown support, while xAI invests heavily in massive infrastructure.
sub: Grok3's conversation history limitations and slow response times.
Evolution of Grok3's interface and markdown formatting improvements.
Grok3 as a rubber duck debugging partner and its unique value.
xAI's immense infrastructure investment for Grok3's accessibility.
Simplifying workflow implementation with Python's webbrowser module.
